recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published rename without broadening scope; any other modernization of the admission JSON example should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-35842 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested renaming Subscription.filterBy.searchParamName to filterParameter so Subscription instances match the definitional SubscriptionTopic canFilterBy naming.
initial_application: Commit 365b52222b9aeb872817b317cd6e620955291d56 applied most of the issue by renaming the authoritative Subscription StructureDefinition element and the main Subscription example while also applying related FHIR-32752 SubscriptionTopic work. Jira then recorded the change as already applied, but source/subscription/subscription-admission.json still used the obsolete searchParamName property.
additional_context: Subscription and SubscriptionTopic are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and source/subscription/list-Subscription-examples.xml includes the Subscription/admission example. The XML version of that example already used filterParameter. Later FHIR-41197 work, already represented on the combined branch, touched the same JSON example for the resourceType-to-resource rename but left the old filter field. FHIR-I minutes corroborate the FHIR-35842 vote, and community searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscription/subscription-admission.json so filterBy uses filterParameter instead of searchParamName, aligning the remaining stale example serialization with the current Subscription and SubscriptionTopic definitions.

related_jiras.note: The original implementation commit also applied SubscriptionTopic filterParameter/filterDefinition changes from this issue, which established the terminology FHIR-35842 aligns to.
Later Subscription.filterBy.resourceType-to-resource rename work touched the same example and is already represented on the combined branch; it did not address the filterParameter field.
